kjv: the beast that was, and is not, and yet is
mine: because it was and is not and is to come
note: TR "kaiper estin" (and yet is) against "kai parestai" (and will be present / is to come; Sinaiticus, A, P), a parody of God's title "who was and is and is to come".

kjv: the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast
mine: the ten horns that you saw, they and the beast
note: TR "epi to therion" (upon the beast) against "kai to therion" (and the beast; Sinaiticus, A, P); the early text makes the beast join the horns in destroying the prostitute.
